whatItFakes: A child benefit's effect on child poverty (child-benefit-to-child-poverty) moves nothing: nothing in the game pays a household a benefit for a child (no law question, bill-catalog policy, budget line or tax credit does; the welfare line's cash assistance goes to household heads below a share of the poverty line, the same amount per household, not per child), so the cause has no value in any place.
why: The research (the Census supplemental measure, 2021 against 2022) is one program's before and after at its own amounts, not a rate per dollar, and the game has no child benefit for it to scale.
addedBy: effects-web family 1 (laws lead), from the family helper's commit e68fb4fa8b
replacement: A child benefit (a law question or bill-catalog policy) paid to each household by its children through the law reach's money group, as the welfare line pays (src/core2/law-reach/group-b-money.ts); the poverty count (householdPoverty in src/core2/world-poverty.ts) then reads it as income, so the link is carried by the payment, not run by the web.

whatItFakes: A birth bonus's effect on births (baby-bonus-to-births) moves nothing: nothing in the game pays a household a bonus for a birth (no law question, bill-catalog policy or budget line does; the child-care assistance topic is unsupported and holds no policy), so the cause, program.birth-bonus-dollars, has no value in any place.
why: Milligan's estimate holds around Quebec's own schedule, by parity and in Canadian dollars, so no per-dollar size carries over to a game bill of another amount.
addedBy: effects-web family 1 (laws lead), from the family helper's commit e68fb4fa8b
replacement: A birth-bonus bill that pays each household on a birth; the link is then sized from that amount through Milligan's benefit elasticity (0.107) and read where births are decided (src/core2/births-plan.ts and src/core2/births-counted.ts already read the web's births.rate factor).

whatItFakes: Marriage equality's effect on same-sex marriages (marriage-equality-to-marriages) moves nothing: marriage equality is not a law question the game holds and has been national law since 2015, so no place differs on it (graded cause cannot vary, the CTO's ruling of Oct 29 in OWNER-DECISIONS.md); the core keeps no marriage (couples exist as the opening drew them, stopgap SG-TRAITS-partnerships-no-engine); and nothing counts same-sex marriages by place.
why: How marriage works in play is not yet decided (OWNER-DECISIONS.md, Marriage and children), and no engine decides who partners or marries.
addedBy: effects-web family 1 (laws lead), from the family helper's commit e68fb4fa8b
replacement: A marriage engine that reads the marriage law in force when two people decide to marry, counting same-sex marriages by place from those records; the link then takes a size in that count's unit.
